scenarios.name: Select an origin axis from filtered browser results

scenario_steps.name: a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser contains X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis under Origin
the user opens browser search and enters "axis"
the browser shows the three matching axes under Origin
the user selects X Axis in the filtered results
the X Axis row is highlighted
its corresponding axis is highlighted in the viewport
the user clears the search using the search close control
X Axis remains selected and highlighted in the viewport
the user activates the search close control again
the user clicks empty viewport space
the axis highlight disappears from the viewport
